# Translation into the Causal-Charge Programme

Entropic gravity rhymes with the causal-charge programme wherever state distinguishability, horizon area, matter flux, and geometric response meet. The rhyme is strongest in Jacobson’s universal area coefficient and Verlinde’s elastic interpretation of a displaced capacity; it becomes misleading whenever entropy, information, susceptibility, charge, and geometry are treated as one untyped substance.

This note translates the vendored constructions into project language without claiming that they instantiate [[conservation-of-causal-charge/inq|conservation of causal charge]].

## Jacobson as a local-interface precedent

[[vendor/entropic-gravity/jacobson-local-horizon-thermodynamics]] has the schematic form

$$
\text{universal areal entropy response}
+\text{boost-energy flux}
+\text{local equilibrium}
\Longrightarrow
\text{Einstein focusing}.
$$

This is a close precedent for the proposed areal weld

$$
\frac{d\mu_{\mathrm{BKM}}^\perp}{d\mu_A}
=\chi_*
$$

in [[conservation-of-causal-charge/state-geometry-charge-weld|the state–geometry charge weld]]. Both ideas seek one universal conversion coefficient between a state-side quantity and causal area.

The difference is decisive. Jacobson begins with the area density and identifies it with \(1/(4\hbar G)\). The causal-charge programme aims to calculate a renormalized state-side density without inserting \(G\), then show that the same coefficient governs horizon entropy. Jacobson supplies a rigorous **downstream theorem template**, not the missing upstream calculation.

This also clarifies the relation to established physics. If a causal-charge construction supplies Jacobson’s premises for every local cut, it could explain why the imported local fiber obeys Einstein dynamics. If the programme instead retains GR as a local fiber, Jacobson remains a compatibility precedent rather than a recovery obligation.

## Entanglement equilibrium is closer than entropic force

The project’s BKM and relative-entropy structures are quadratic or Hessian objects. Jacobson’s small-ball total-entropy stationarity,

$$
\delta S_{\mathrm{tot}}|_V=0,
$$

is therefore more closely typed to the project than the particle equation

$$
F=T\nabla S.
$$

Here \(S_{\mathrm{tot}}=\eta A+S_{\mathrm{IR}}\); it has the generalized-entropy form only after \(\eta=1/(4\hbar G)\) is identified. Stationarity of this total and its later relation to canonical energy remain distinct from a conserved charge.

Even here the quantities must remain distinct:

$$
\begin{array}{rcl}
S_{\mathrm{vN}}(\rho) &:& \text{entropy of one state},\\
S(\rho\Vert\sigma) &:& \text{relative distinguishability of a state pair},\\
g^{\mathrm{BKM}}_\rho(v,v) &:& \text{quadratic response of one tangent},\\
\mu_\xi &:& \text{linear moment map or charge},\\
S_{\mathrm{hor}} &:& \text{geometric entropy assigned to a causal boundary}.
\end{array}
$$

Controlled identities may relate some of these on the same perturbation. They are not synonyms. In particular, stationarity of a sum of entropies is not conservation of a Noether charge.

## Verlinde’s potential as a scale coordinate

[[vendor/entropic-gravity/verlinde-entropic-force]] interprets the Newtonian potential as a coarse-graining coordinate and its equipotential surfaces as holographic screens. This strongly rhymes with [[scale-as-modular-observable/observable-map|scale as a horizontal state coordinate]]:

$$
\text{physical scale}
\longmapsto
\text{family of information-bearing states}.
$$

But Verlinde defines the screens through the very potential whose force law is being reconstructed. The state family, entropy gradient, and bit distribution are not calculated independently of \(\Phi\). The causal-scale programme’s elimination test is therefore stricter: construct the scale-indexed state family and its cocycle without first reading it backward from \(H(z)\), \(G\), or the desired force.

The useful import is the **question**—whether gravitational potential is the observable shadow of a deeper coarse-graining coordinate—not the particular screen assignment as an established answer.

## Entropy displacement and residual susceptibility

[[vendor/entropic-gravity/verlinde-emergent-gravity]] proposes

$$
\text{matter localization}
\longrightarrow
\text{de Sitter entropy deficit}
\longrightarrow
\text{elastic geometric response}.
$$

This is close in spirit to the causal-charge conjecture

$$
\text{resolved causal order}
+\text{residual susceptibility}
=\text{fixed representation invariant},
$$

with geometry as the constitutive image of the susceptibility. Both deny that geometry is merely an inert container; localization changes what the arena must carry.

They are not yet the same mechanism:

- Verlinde’s deficit is defined relative to an assumed de Sitter volume-law entropy; the binary Casimir balance is an exact identity inside a specified representation.
- Verlinde’s response coefficient already contains \(G\); the proposed BKM–area weld must not.
- Verlinde uses a spatial elastic strain tensor; causal charge is prospective linear boundary charge, while BKM capacity is quadratic.
- Verlinde’s general result is an inequality; causal-charge language must not turn it into an exact conversion law by verbal analogy.
- Verlinde studies an effective galaxy-scale force; the causal-charge programme asks about the arena of facthood and cosmic scale history.

The last difference is not a weakness. It means the project may borrow a constitutive grammar without inheriting the same object of inquiry.

## A typed translation dictionary

| Vendored term | Possible project translation | Type warning |
|---|---|---|
| local horizon entropy density | areal causal-capacity density | entropy variation is not automatically a BKM measure |
| matter boost heat \(\delta Q\) | state or matter flux through a causal wall | stress-energy flux is not the total causal charge |
| entanglement first law | same-tangent linear response | one-state entropy and relative entropy have different arguments |
| screen bit density | local channel density per area | no wall algebra or state count follows from the metaphor |
| entropy removed by matter | accessible distinguishability deficit | a deficit is not a complementary physical sector until a map is constructed |
| elastic strain | geometric compliance or response | strain is a tensor; capacity is quadratic; charge is linear |
| de Sitter volume law | extensive cosmic capacity | it is a postulate in Verlinde, not a theorem of causal structure |
| apparent dark mass | effective gravitational representation of a residual sector | an effective source is not necessarily matter or conserved information |

## None of the vendored laws is the sought conservation law

The Clausius relation balances heat with entropy change. The non-equilibrium extension includes positive entropy production. Entanglement equilibrium is a stationarity condition. Entropic force is virtual work. Verlinde’s elastic relation matches strain energy to a displaced volume. None provides a common continuous symmetry with an additive moment map

$$
\mu_{\mathrm{causal}}
=\mu_{\mathrm{state}}
+\mu_{\mathrm{grav}}
+\mu_{\mathrm{record}}.
$$

That is the Noether gap identified in [[conservation-of-causal-charge/indiscernibility-and-the-noether-gap|indiscernibility and the Noether gap]]. Thermodynamic balance is excellent evidence that several registers meet at causal boundaries; it is not by itself proof that they are components of one conserved charge.

## What is worth importing

The vendored work suggests four precise construction tests.

1. **All-cut universality.** A proposed local balance should hold for every admissible causal cut and direction, as in Jacobson, rather than on one fitted cosmological horizon.
2. **Same-tangent comparison.** State entropy, BKM response, and gravitational canonical energy must be evaluated on one explicitly soldered perturbation.
3. **Inequality before equality.** Data processing, positivity, and elastic bounds should be retained as one-sided statements until a real saturation theorem is proved.
4. **Coefficient independence.** A derivation of \(G\) must compute the state-side areal density without using \(G\) in its regulator, state normalization, horizon area, or elastic modulus.

The philosophical lesson is equally useful: gravity may be the compliance of the arena of facts, not an additional stock of “information.” Entropic gravity makes that thought vivid. Causal charge must make its types and conservation law precise.
